Packers Defeat Jets in Week 2 Game

The Green Bay Packers secured a victory over the New York Jets in their Week 2 game. Standout performances were noted from the Packers' side. Lukas Van Ness cleared concussion protocol, while Javon Hargrave was ruled out for the Jets game.
